title: The theme applied on this machine
description: What `theme current show --json` prints: the theme applied on this machine, read from the current file in theme's state directory and that theme's theme.yml, with no sync and no network. Every field but schema_version is null when no theme is applied. display_name and neovim_colorscheme_name are null when the applied theme's theme.yml is not installed.

id.description: The theme's id: its directory under themes/, and meta.id in its theme.yml.

display_name.description: meta.display_name from the theme's theme.yml, the name a person reads.

neovim_colorscheme_name.description: meta.neovim_colorscheme_name from the theme's theme.yml, the name Neovim's :colorscheme is called with. It may differ from the id, as OceanicNext does for oceanic-next.
